dashboard.subtitle: Courses you have joined, most recent first.

dashboard.loadFailed: Your courses could not be loaded.
dashboard.completionStands: Your completion stands. The remaining lessons are optional.

login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Sign in to continue learning.
login.failed: Sign-in failed. Check your email and password.
login.unconfirmed: Confirm your email address before signing in. Check your inbox for the link.

verify.confirmedBody: Your address is verified. You can sign in now.
verify.failedBody: It may have expired or already been used. Sign in and request a new one.

forgot.title: Forgot your password?
forgot.subtitle: We will email you a link to set a new one.
forgot.maybeSent: If that address has an account, a reset link is on its way. Check your inbox, and your spam folder.

reset.title: Set a new password
reset.doneBody: Your password is set. You have been signed out everywhere else.
reset.noLink: This page needs the link from your reset email.
reset.failed: That did not work. Please try again.

common.title: Title
common.slugHint: Left blank, generated from the title
common.genericError: Something went wrong. Please try again.
common.name: Name

articles.subtitle: Every article, across all statuses.
articles.summaryHint: Used as the excerpt and meta description fallback.
articles.slugHintLocked: Immutable once published — moving it needs a 301 redirect.
articles.slugHintFree: Leave blank to derive from the title.
articles.metaTitleHint: Falls back to the article title.
articles.publishAtHint: Your local time. Saves the draft first, then schedules it.
articles.pickDate: Pick a date and time to schedule this article.
articles.futureOnly: The scheduled time must be in the future.
articles.noVersions: No versions yet — history starts at the first publish.
articles.restoreConfirm: Restore version {version}? This replaces the current draft. Nothing published changes.

courses.subtitle: Curricula built from lesson bodies. A course can go live before every lesson is written.
courses.empty: No courses yet. Create one, then add modules and attach lesson bodies to it.
courses.durationHint: Duration is summed from the lessons, so it cannot drift from the curriculum.
courses.slugHint: Leave blank to derive from the title. Immutable once published.
courses.removeLessonConfirm: Remove this lesson from the course? The lesson body is not deleted.
courses.hiddenHint: Their bodies are still drafts. The course can be published without them — a learner simply will not see them until each body is published.

lessons.empty: No lesson bodies yet. Write one, publish it, then attach it to a course.
lessons.subtitleFull: Lesson bodies. Write one here, then attach it to a course — the same body can appear in more than one.
lessons.noVersions: No versions yet — history starts at the first publish.
lessons.unpublishWarning: Unpublishing removes this lesson from every course that uses it, without warning the courses. Content has no way to ask which curricula depend on a body — that is the module boundary, not an oversight.
lessons.slugHint: Leave blank to derive from the title. Must be unique across articles and lessons alike.
lessons.restoreConfirm: Restore version {version}? This replaces the current draft. Nothing published changes.

paths.subtitle: Curated sequences of courses. A path can be assembled before the courses in it are live.
paths.empty: No learning paths yet. Create one, then add courses to it in the order you would teach them.
paths.sequenceHint: Order is what a path is. Courses that are not published still sit here — they are simply absent from the learner's view until they go live.
paths.noCourses: No courses in this path yet.
paths.allAdded: Every course is already in this path
paths.publishHint: A path needs at least one course to go live. Those courses do not have to be published — the learner sees the ones that are.

quizzes.subtitle: One quiz per lesson. Create a quiz from its lesson, then write the questions here.
quizzes.empty: No quizzes yet. Open a lesson and add one.
quizzes.atLeastOneCorrect: A question needs at least one correct answer.
quizzes.publishHint: Every question needs at least two choices and a correct answer before the quiz can go live.

attempts.empty: No one has submitted this quiz yet.

media.loadFailed: Could not load the media library.
media.variantsFailed: Responsive sizes failed — the full-size image still works.

taxonomy.subtitle: Categories are hierarchical and an article has at most one. Tags are flat and an article can have any number.
taxonomy.categorySlugHint: Leave blank to derive from the name. Immutable afterwards.
taxonomy.tagSlugHint: Leave blank to derive from the name.

blocks.noBlocks: No blocks yet. Add one below.
blocks.noForm: No form for {type} yet — it still renders.
blocks.embedHint: Only allowlisted providers are framed; anything else renders as a plain link.
blocks.tableHint: Cells take inline formatting — bold, links and
blocks.tableHintTail: — because comparison tables lean on it. The header row is what makes the table readable to a screen reader, so leave it filled in.
blocks.altHintBefore: Alt text describes the image in
blocks.altHintAfter: article. Leave empty only if the image is purely decorative.
